event.own_time.description: An event's time in the event's own time zone, after the same time in the reader's zone, shown when the two zones differ: time is the time as the reader's locale writes it (Sat 9:00 PM), zone the place name of the event's zone (Tokyo).

event.new_tab.description: Said after a link of an event that leaves the site (a place online, a place's map), for assistive technology: host is the site it leads to (meet.example.com), which also shows beside the link.
